rationale: Record that an opt-in build flag crosses the design-output-and-packaging selector without touching anything the family is about. `pulp build --seed-build` (or PULP_SEED_BUILD=1) clones and retargets a sibling worktree's warm Ninja build dir via the new tools/scripts/seed_build_dir.py before a fresh worktree's first configure. The family is crossed by docs/status/cli-commands.yaml and docs/status/tools.yaml (the new flag and the tool registry entry). No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold, packaging artifact or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
